positive_snippets: Rooms are good. The room which I selected had old AC without remote. Hotel ambience is good. Cleanliness is good. In bathrooms hot water was not available and food rates are bit high. Complementary breakfast was available.

The staff is not cooperative at all. Everybody gives 1 water bottle on daily basis but they refuse. The remote of the AC was broken and they had no solution for it.When I asked for a blanket for the night he refused.
Don't even think of trying the buffet. They don't provide anything according to the money and the taste is also not that great.

I stayed there for 10+ days. Hotel is located on the main road. Easily reachable from Delhi airport. Rooms are good also food is good. Staffs are also friendly and well behaved. They provide a number of options for the breakfast. Overall a nice stay I had.
